item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #SLPRSD
Issued at 12:45 AM 20 September 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #CamarinesNorte(Paracale, Vinzons, Talisay, Daet), #Marinduque(SantaCruz, Torrijos), #Romblon(SanJose, SantaFe, Looc, Alcantara, Ferrol, Concepcion), #OrientalMindoro(Bulalacao, Pinamalayan, Gloria and Bansud) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 3 #SLPRSD
Issued at 05:30 PM 19 September 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #CamarinesSur(SanJose, Caramoan, Calabanga, NagaCity, Pili, Ocampo, Tigaon) and #OrientalMindoro(Bongabong) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #CamarinesSur(Garchitorena, Presentacion, Lagonoy, Tinambac, Siruma, Goa), #OrientalMindoro(Victoria, Socorro, Pinamalayan, Gloria and Bansud) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
